intro.title: Moving the hand
intro.text: Slide your hand up so your thumb sits on G. Now your fingers cover G A B C D: G position.

intro.title: A
intro.text: A sits in the second space of the staff.

intro.title: B
intro.text: B is on the middle line.

intro.title: High C
intro.text: The C above middle C, in the third space.
